question: Was exposure of test material in training data assessed?
shown_means: the risk acknowledged; a safeguard described
checked_means: a contamination check or held out procedure reported

applicability.reason: B14 applies always under the frozen rubric.

check.procedure: Auditor reading of the benchmark posts and the Gemini 3.8 Flash provider page for a contamination check or held out procedure covering this model on SWE-bench Verified. No probe of the model was run, because model sessions are outside preparation. Neither the sources nor the auditor performed a check of this kind; the search above looked for one.
check.detection_limits: Provider documents not saved here, such as system cards, were not read.

evidence.location: OpenAI, Introducing SWE-bench Verified (2024), https://openai.com/index/introducing-swe-bench-verified/, section Discussion & Limitations
evidence.quote: large foundation models that are pre-trained on internet text are likely to be contaminated on the tasks

evidence.location: OpenAI, Why SWE-bench Verified no longer measures frontier coding capabilities (2026), https://openai.com/index/why-we-no-longer-evaluate-swe-bench-verified/, opening
Google DeepMind, Gemini 3.8 Flash model card, https://deepmind.google/models/model-cards/gemini-3-8-flash/, section Known Limitations
evidence.quote: The knowledge cutoff date for Gemini 3.8 Flash is March 2026

evidence.location: OpenAI, Why SWE-bench Verified no longer measures frontier coding capabilities (2026), https://openai.com/index/why-we-no-longer-evaluate-swe-bench-verified/, section Contamination, Gemini 3 Flash example
evidence.quote: is able to output verbatim details from the task description and the gold patch

reasons: No source reports a contamination check or held out procedure for Gemini 3.8 Flash on SWE-bench Verified. The sources acknowledge the risk, and the 2026 audit reports examples of strong contamination in Gemini 3 Flash Preview, an earlier model of the same family. The SymPy source tasks date from 2016 to 2023, before the training cutoff. The proposed state is Insufficient evidence (stored as Undocumented) because the defect is shown for other models, not this one.
missing: A contamination check of Gemini 3.8 Flash on the SymPy tasks, or a held out procedure for this model.
checks_performed: reading of the 2024 and 2026 OpenAI posts
reading of the Gemini 3.8 Flash provider page

roles.assistant: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) drafted this form from the cited sources; no auditor check was run for B14. The anchor is a proposal for the author, who reviews, changes if needed, and signs.

instructions: Record evidence locations with short quotes, the check performed, its outcome, detection limits, and reasons. The check outcome is the result of the check described in the procedure; state whether the benchmark sources report it or the auditor performed it. A rating without evidence and reasons is incomplete. Missing evidence is not a defect; a defect needs a cited location, and an oracle defect needs an executed counterexample.
